rules.rationale: This guarded base equation defines standaloneLastLetter on empty IntSeq values as false; it is part of the mathematical summary and does not replace program execution.
This guarded equation defines standaloneLastLetter for positive-length inputs whose final modeled character is nonalphabetic; it is a case of the result summary.
This guarded equation defines the one-character alphabetic case of standaloneLastLetter as true and is part of the summary's case split.
This guarded equation defines the longer alphabetic case by testing whether the penultimate code is literal space code 32; it completes the mathematical result summary.

This simplification adds the mathematical constructor-disjointness fact that a nonempty iCons IntSeq is not .IntSeq. Stage 1 compiles the rule into VERIFICATION before every kprove command and contains no prior lemma-free proof of this exact statement, so it is trusted rather than proved.

This simplification adds the mathematical injectivity fact reducing equality of singleton iCons sequences to equality of their integer codes.
